articles.title: Mega-Sena 3078 teve vencedor em Santa Catarina? | G1
articles.standfirst: Prêmio acumulou e vai a R$ 6 milhões. Apostas de SC vencedoras são de Balneário Camboriú, Blumenau, Guaramirim e Navegantes.
articles.summary: Apostas de SC que acertaram 5 números são de Balneário Camboriú, Blumenau, Guaramirim e Navegantes.
articles.body:
Quatro apostas simples de Santa Catarina acertaram cinco números no concurso 3078 da Mega-Sena . O sorteio foi feito na noite desta quinta-feira (29). Ninguém levou a faixa principal e o valor acumulou para R$ 6 milhões.

Cada aposta catarinense que acertou cinco números levou R$ 20.770,47 . Outras 119 apostas catarinenses acertaram quatro números. Cada uma levou R$ 394,27 .

Veja os números sorteados: 05 - 07 - 12 - 29 - 34 - 36

Confira abaixo os detalhes das apostas catarinenses que acertaram cinco números:

Balneário Camboriú - feita na Lotérica Balneário

Guaramirim - feita na Casa Lotérica Amizade

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.title: Justiça do Trabalho manda Meta remover publicações que incentivam demissão por causa do voto | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão também obriga a empresa a avisar usuários de Instagram, Facebook e Threads no Brasil de que discriminação política e assédio eleitoral no trabalho são proibidos. Meta diz que não comenta o caso.
articles.summary: Decisão também obriga a empresa a avisar usuários de Instagram, Facebook e Threads no Brasil de que discriminação política e assédio eleitoral no trabalho são proibidos.
articles.body:
A Justiça do Trabalho determinou nesta quinta-feira (29) que a Meta retire do ar, em até 24 horas, publicações no Instagram que incentivam empresários a vigiar, expor e demitir funcionários por causa do voto.

Segundo a decisão, a empresa também terá de exibir, em até 72 horas e por cinco dias seguidos, um aviso a todos os usuários do Instagram, do Facebook e do Threads no Brasil informando que a discriminação por convicção política e o assédio eleitoral no emprego são proibidos.

A liminar foi concedida em uma ação do Ministério Público do Trabalho (MPT) , que também pediu R$ 50 milhões de indenização por danos morais coletivos. A Justiça afirmou que esse pedido específico será analisado no julgamento da ação.

Após o segundo turno das eleições, em 25 de outubro, começaram a circular nas plataformas publicações que incentivam empregadores a perseguir funcionários por causa do voto .

Nelas, empresários, influenciadores e até parlamentares orientam patrões a vasculhar as redes sociais dos trabalhadores para descobrir em quem votaram e demitir aqueles que tenham escolhido um candidato diferente do apoiado pelo empregador.

Outras publicações expõem trabalhadores à ridicularização, com nome e imagem, ou comemoram demissões.

Segundo o MPT, apenas quatro publicações de um único perfil, que tem selo de verificação e 3,8 milhões de seguidores, somavam mais de 2 milhões de curtidas .

Entre a meia-noite de 26 de outubro e as 12h desta quinta-feira (29), o MPT recebeu 1.459 denúncias de assédio eleitoral . Ao todo, foram registradas 3.396 denúncias nas eleições deste ano .

Para o juiz Bruno José Perusso, da 77ª Vara do Trabalho de São Paulo, as publicações ultrapassam a livre manifestação de pensamento e incentivam condutas discriminatórias baseadas exclusivamente na opção política dos empregados.

“Uma coisa é externar opinião política ou crítica partidária; outra, inteiramente distinta e ilícita, é utilizar as plataformas digitais para instigar a punição de trabalhadores por suas escolhas ideológicas”, diz trecho da decisão.

O magistrado lembrou que o empregador pode demitir sem informar o motivo, mas não por questões exclusivamente políticas, o que a Constituição proíbe.

Além de retirar as publicações do ar, a Meta deverá excluí-las imediatamente dos sistemas de recomendação, como a aba Explorar e os Reels sugeridos, e avisar os responsáveis pelos perfis, em até 48 horas , de que a remoção ocorreu por ordem da Justiça do Trabalho.

A empresa também terá de preservar os conteúdos e seus dados técnicos até o fim do processo. O descumprimento da liminar pode resultar em multa de R$ 200 mil.

Ministério Público Eleitoral afirma que Meta não cumpriu medidas para tratamento igualitário às campanhas presidenciais — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Na ação, o MPT afirma que a Meta tem responsabilidade pela circulação desse conteúdo . Segundo o órgão, além de permitir que publicações consideradas ilegais permanecessem no ar por dias, os sistemas de recomendação da empresa, como a aba “Explorar” e os Reels sugeridos, ampliam o alcance de conteúdos que geram mais engajamento.

As postagens continuavam disponíveis dois dias após a publicação, embora as próprias regras da Meta prevejam a remoção de conteúdos que violem a lei.

Para o MPT, a empresa já dispõe de sistemas automatizados, combinados com revisão humana, capazes de identificar e remover outros tipos de conteúdo em larga escala.

“Se não os emprega para identificar a incitação à discriminação de trabalhadores por convicção política, é por escolha, e não por impossibilidade técnica”, afirmam os procuradores que assinam a ação.

Em caráter de urgência, o MPT pediu que a Meta:

Remova, em até 24 horas, publicações de assédio eleitoral, sob multa de R$ 500 mil por conteúdo mantido no ar;

exiba a todos os usuários brasileiros um aviso de que não compactua com manifestações que incentivem discriminação, retaliação ou punição de empregados por orientação política;

notifique os perfis responsáveis por conteúdos ilegais;

suspenda por 30 dias os perfis que voltarem a publicar esse tipo de conteúdo;

desative as contas em caso de nova reincidência.

O órgão também pediu que a Meta crie uma política permanente de prevenção ao assédio eleitoral , altere suas regras de uso para proibir expressamente esse tipo de conteúdo, reforce a moderação durante períodos eleitorais e preste contas periodicamente à Justiça .

A ação foi assinada pelo procurador-geral do Trabalho, Gláucio Araújo de Oliveira, pela procuradora-chefe do MPT-SP, Vera Lúcia Carlos, e pelos procuradores Igor Gonçalves, Luciana Coutinho, Tatiana Amormino, Diego Jimenez e Marcos Cutrim.

O g1 procurou a Meta, que informou, em nota, que não comentará o assunto.

articles.title: Patixa Teló se encanta com o maior aquário de água doce do mundo   | G1
articles.standfirst: A "Rainha do Amazonas" conheceu o maior aquário de água doce do mundo, cantou, dançou e falou ao g1 sobre o carinho dos fãs e os planos para o futuro.
articles.summary: A "Rainha do Amazonas" conheceu o maior aquário de água doce do mundo, cantou, dançou e falou ao g1 sobre o carinho dos fãs e os planos para o futuro.
articles.body:
Uma das personalidades mais queridas da internet, Patixa Teló conheceu o Bioparque Pantanal nesta quinta-feira (29), durante sua passagem por Campo Grande . No atrativo turístico, a “rainha do Amazonas”, como ficou conhecida, cantou, dançou, tirou fotos com fãs e se encantou com os peixes do maior aquário de água doce do mundo.

🔎 Patixa Teló se tornou um fenômeno nas redes sociais com seus conteúdos divertidos e ganhou ainda mais notoriedade após participar, em 2024, do reality show “Rancho do Maia”, idealizado pelo influenciador Carlinhos Maia. Desde então a popularidade dela só aumentou, rendendo uma infinidade de memes nas redes sociais.

A influenciadora chegou ao Bioparque esbanjando a simpatia e a irreverência que a tornaram famosa na internet.

No primeiro momento, porém, ela ficou receosa de entrar no atrativo. O imenso aquário instalado no auditório, logo na entrada do Bioparque, impressionou Patixa. Mas não demorou para que a “rainha” se soltasse e começasse a divertir quem estava por perto.

Patixa entrou no Bioparque dançando e cantando “Eu Vou Te Dar uma Surra de Amor” , parceria musical com o cantor Thássio. A performance inesperada, claro, arrancou gargalhadas da equipe do atrativo.

Patixa Teló curtindo o Biopaque Pantanal. — Foto: Adriano Fernandes.

Antes mesmo de começar a visita pelos aquários, Patixa aproveitou para tirar fotos e conversar com os fãs. Ela também se emocionou ao observar os animais empalhados expostos no local ao descobrir que eles haviam sido vítimas de atropelamentos.

Durante o passeio, a influenciadora ficou fascinada com a quantidade e a variedade de espécies do aquário. “É muito peixe”, comentou. Ela ainda arrancou mais gargalhadas ao perguntar se o Bioparque também tinha exemplares da uma espécie das amigas dela: “as piranhas”.

O riso, por sinal, vem fácil para quem acompanha Patixa. Em entrevista ao g1, ela contou que ficou encantada não apenas com o Bioparque Pantanal, mas também com Campo Grande.

“Campo Grande é muito lindo. Achei lindo, só que eu não dei volta pelos bairros”, comentou.

Patixa Teló no Bioparque Pantanal. — Foto: Adriano Fernandes.

A influenciadora também falou sobre como se sente ao perceber o carinho de milhares de pessoas que acompanham sua trajetória pelas redes sociais.

“Eu estou muito feliz por ser famosa no Brasil. E esse é o Brasil que vai agradar meu coração”, afirmou.

Sempre irreverente, Patixa também contou como está se sentindo nesta nova fase da vida.

“Graças a Deus, eu estou feliz. Estou grande, sou rica, tenho dinheiro, não quero saber de homem nenhum. Quero saber agora é do meu trabalho”, disse, arrancando mais risadas.

E os planos para o futuro não são modestos. Com a espontaneidade de sempre, ela deixou uma promessa para os fãs: “Me aguarde que eu vou estar na Globo”. Patixa deve deixar Campo Grande nesta sexta-feira (30), após um encontro com os fãs campo-grandenses.

Nascida em Manaus , ela se mudou para Goiânia em meados de agosto, onde começou uma nova fase pessoal e profissional.

Atualmente, Patixa passa por acompanhamento com uma equipe multidisciplinar, que inclui dentista, fonoaudiólogo e médicos, com o objetivo de cuidar da saúde. Ela também está aprendendo a ler e a escrever.

A transformação faz parte de um projeto para impulsionar sua carreira, ampliar sua presença no mercado publicitário e abrir caminho para o lançamento de produtos próprios.

articles.title: A indústria de Manaus na disputa pelo próximo pneu da sua moto | G1
articles.standfirst: Para a indústria instalada no Brasil, o avanço dos pneus importados coloca uma questão: como competir sem comprometer a capacidade de produzir e investir no país?
articles.summary: Para a indústria instalada no Brasil, o avanço dos pneus importados coloca uma questão: como competir sem comprometer a capacidade de produzir e investir no país?
articles.body:
Produção de bicicletas na Zona Franca de Manaus (ZFM) — Foto: Divulgação/Abraciclo

Para quem precisa trocar o pneu da motocicleta, o preço pesa na decisão. Especialmente quando o veículo é instrumento de trabalho, qualquer despesa de manutenção disputa espaço com combustível, alimentação e outras contas. É compreensível que uma oferta mais barata encontre compradores. No entanto, para a indústria instalada no Brasil, o avanço dos pneus importados coloca uma questão: como competir sem comprometer a capacidade de produzir e investir no país?

Os números mostram uma mudança expressiva. Segundo a Associação Nacional da Indústria de Pneumáticos (Anip), com base no ComexStat e ajustes metodológicos, as importações de pneus de passeio, comerciais leves e carga cresceram 58,3% entre janeiro e agosto de 2026, enquanto as vendas dos fabricantes nacionais para reposição recuaram 13,3%, em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. A China respondeu por 81% das importações de pneus de passeio. Essa participação, entretanto, não pode ser aplicada automaticamente aos demais segmentos.

Nas motocicletas, essa dinâmica também merece atenção, já que as importações aumentaram 26,2%, enquanto as vendas nacionais para reposição caíram 3,7%. A participação dos produtos estrangeiros nesse mercado passou de 27% para 33%. A produção brasileira ainda predomina, mas perdeu espaço.

Como Manaus abriga o segmento de duas rodas do Polo Industrial de Manaus (PIM), esse assunto ganha ainda mais relevância local. O Polo não apenas abriga a tradicional operação da Michelin, como também passou a receber a nova estrutura industrial da Etor Pneus, marca ligada ao Grupo Cairu. Na Etor, o início da fabricação do composto de borracha foi anunciado em julho de 2026 — um avanço industrial importante, mas que ainda precisa ser distinguido da produção comercial regular e em larga escala de pneus acabados.

A operação dessas fábricas joga luz sobre um lado menos visível do PIM.

O desempenho das montadoras importa, mas a força de uma cadeia produtiva depende também das oportunidades que chegam aos fabricantes de componentes. Uma motocicleta vendida gera demanda potencial de manutenção durante anos. Quem atenderá esse consumidor nas próximas trocas de pneus também participará dos resultados desse mercado.

A pressão competitiva atua sobre preço, margem e escala. Quando uma fábrica vende menos, pode ter maior dificuldade para distribuir seus custos fixos entre as unidades produzidas. Reduzir preços para preservar clientes, por sua vez, pode diminuir os recursos disponíveis para modernização ou outros investimentos. É um mecanismo econômico possível, não uma situação comprovada para cada empresa de Manaus. Os dados nacionais não permitem atribuir perdas específicas às operações locais.

No contexto regional, a competição impõe desafios adicionais que vão além das barreiras comerciais. As indústrias instaladas em Manaus lidam com a complexidade da infraestrutura local, onde o escoamento e o abastecimento dependem criticamente dos rios. Em períodos de forte vazante amazônica, o custo logístico é pressionado, tornando o planejamento operacional dessas fábricas ainda mais complexo frente aos concorrentes estrangeiros que chegam aos principais portos do país por rotas de longo curso.

Essa dinâmica econômica reflete-se diretamente no mercado de trabalho do Amazonas. O PIM é o principal motor de empregos formais da região, e a perda de espaço da cadeia de componentes para os produtos importados gera preocupações sobre a sustentabilidade dos postos de trabalho locais. Por isso, garantir a competitividade dessas fábricas é também uma estratégia para proteger o emprego de técnicos, operadores e especialistas que dependem diretamente da atividade fabril no estado.

Também seria precipitado concluir que a diferença de preço decorre sempre de irregularidade. Escala de fabricação, produtividade, câmbio, frete e estratégia comercial podem influenciar o valor final. A Anip denuncia condições que considera desleais; os importadores defendem sua participação como fonte de concorrência, diversidade e preços mais acessíveis. São interesses que precisam ser examinados com evidências, sem transformar a origem do produto em julgamento automático sobre sua qualidade.

O histórico recente da Michelin mostra que essa disputa pode ter consequências industriais. A companhia encerrou, no fim de 2025, a fábrica de Guarulhos, que produzia principalmente câmaras de ar para motos e bicicletas, além de pneus industriais e produtos semiacabados. A empresa atribuiu a decisão à concorrência de importados asiáticos e à inviabilidade econômica da operação. O fechamento não representou sua saída do Brasil: a unidade de Manaus permanece ativa.

Outro episódio expõe a importância da qualidade das informações na defesa comercial. Em fevereiro de 2026, o governo encerrou, sem julgamento de mérito, a revisão do antidumping sobre pneus de bicicleta da China, Índia e Vietnã, por considerar comprometida a confiabilidade dos dados apresentados pela Michelin. A companhia contestou a decisão e afirmou ter fornecido as informações solicitadas. O processo tratava de uma cobrança adicional sobre importações.

A nova operação da Etor no PIM acrescenta outra perspectiva. Enquanto uma operação estabelecida enfrenta um mercado mais disputado, um novo investimento procura construir seu espaço. Para o Amazonas, isso reforça a necessidade de acompanhar tanto a implantação das fábricas quanto suas condições de competir: produtividade, qualificação profissional, abastecimento, logística e acesso aos clientes.

Elevar barreiras à importação pode fazer parte do debate, mas não substitui essa agenda. O consumidor precisa de preços acessíveis, produtos seguros e informação para avaliar durabilidade, garantia e adequação ao uso. A indústria precisa de condições de concorrência verificáveis e de eficiência para conquistar esse comprador.

O interesse do Amazonas está em transformar a expansão das duas rodas em oportunidades duradouras ao longo da cadeia. Acompanhar apenas quantas motocicletas saem das linhas de montagem deixa uma parte importante dessa história de fora: quem fabrica as peças que manterão esses veículos circulando.

* Cristina Monte é jornalista, colunista e analista de negócios, com atuação na cobertura de indústria, inovação e desenvolvimento econômico na Amazônia.

articles.title: Sobe para 69 o número de mortos no acidente entre dois trens na Espanha | G1
articles.standfirst: O Itamaraty confirmou que uma brasileira está entre os mais de 100 feridos na tragédia.
articles.summary: O Itamaraty confirmou que uma brasileira está entre os mais de 100 feridos na tragédia.
articles.body:
Subiu para 69 o número de mortos no acidente entre dois trens na Espanha . O Itamaraty confirmou que uma brasileira está entre os mais de 100 feridos na tragédia.

Em estações, um minuto de silêncio em memória aos mortos. E, no local do acidente, mais um dia de busca angustiante por vítimas. Equipes usaram drones para visualizar a destruição e guindastes para levantar destroços dos trens que viajavam de Madri para Sevilha. O marido de uma sobrevivente contou que ela está em estado de choque:

"Foi um turbilhão de cabos, fumaça, gritos, choro, vidros quebrados, computadores e malas voando. Depois, um silêncio repentino. E então, mais gritos e choro", afirmou.

Equipes estão coletando amostras de DNA para identificar todos os mortos. Cerca de 50 pessoas ainda estão internadas. O Itamaraty confirmou que entre os mais de 100 feridos há uma brasileira.

Ao visitar um hospital, o Rei Felipe reforçou que a investigação precisa esclarecer as causas. Já se sabe que houve uma pane no sistema que controla a distância entre os trens. Por isso, várias composições pararam e a central de controle passou a orientar a circulação. Os controladores autorizaram um dos trens a seguir viagem, com velocidade normal, como mostra a conversa gravada com o maquinista. O condutor ainda questiona: " Com velocidade normal? ". E os controladores confirmam que sim. O normal para o trecho era 200 km/h.

Sobe para 69 o número de mortos no acidente entre dois trens na Espanha — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Naquele momento, ainda tinha um outro trem à frente, que também recebeu autorização para partir. A maquinista tentou reiniciar o sistema duas vezes, só que não conseguiu. Ela chegou a avisar a central. Mas, cinco minutos depois, o trem em movimento bateu na traseira do que ainda estava parado.

A Espanha tem a maior rede de trens de alta velocidade de toda a Europa. No mundo, só a China está à frente. Mas a segunda tragédia em nove meses abalou o que era motivo de orgulho para os espanhóis. Uma manifestação, na quarta-feira (28), em frente ao Ministério dos Transportes, terminou em confronto entre policiais e manifestantes.

A menos de um mês das eleições, os dois principais partidos suspenderam os atos de campanha. O primeiro-ministro Pedro Sanchez, que tenta se reeleger, disse:

"Todas as instituições estão trabalhando dia e noite para oferecer apoio às famílias, esclarecer cada detalhe da tragédia e reforçar as medidas de segurança para que isso nunca mais se repita”.

articles.title: Patrick Stewart morre, aos 86 anos, em Los Angeles | G1
articles.standfirst: O ator britânico ficou conhecido pelos papéis em 'Jornada nas Estrelas' e 'X-Men'.
articles.summary: O ator britânico ficou conhecido pelos papéis em 'Jornada nas Estrelas' e 'X-Men'.
articles.body:
Morreu em Los Angeles, aos 86 anos, Sir.Patrick Stewart. O o ator britânico ficou conhecido pelas séries "Jornada nas Estrelas" e "X-Men".

Não era uma combinação óbvia. A intelectualidade inglesa e a ficção científica americana. No set de filmagem, Patrick Stewart chegou a ser apelidado de o desconhecido ator de estilo shakespeariano. Era o início da carreira no cinema em um país longe de casa.

Patrick Stewart nasceu em 1940, no interior da Inglaterra. A casa não tinha água quente, e a família enfrentava o alcoolismo e a violência doméstica. A arte entrou cedo na vida do jovem que, aos 11 anos, começou a estudar teatro. Em 1957, ganhou uma bolsa para estudar artes cênicas. Nos anos 1960, fez parte da mais prestigiada companhia de teatro do Reino Unido, a Royal Shakespeare Company.

Se, em casa, Patrick Stewart era fiel aos palcos, nos Estados Unidos, ele também desenvolveu laços com o teatro. Estreou na Broadway, a nata das artes cênicas americanas, em 1971. Depois, partiu para conquistar os cinemas. Mas, como bom filho que à casa retorna, ele voltaria muitas vezes a teatros da Broadway ao longo da carreira.

Patrick Stewart morre, aos 86 anos, em Los Angeles — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

O contato com a ficção científica veio em 1984, com a atuação na versão original de “Duna”, do diretor David Lynch. Mas foi o diplomático e intelectual capitão da nave Enterprise, que explorava a galáxia em busca de novos mundos e civilizações, o personagem que o lançou ao cume do estrelato. Interpretando Jean-Luc Picard na série americana “Star Trek: A Nova Geração”, Stewart virou um ícone da ficção científica. Ficou no papel por sete temporadas e viveu o capitão em quatro filmes da franquia, entre 1994 e 2002. E também mais tarde, em uma série em que o capitão voltava da aposentadoria.

Em 2000, ganhou outro personagem icônico: o professor Charles Xavier, o mutante telepata de X-Men. Foram mais de 20 anos no papel. Ele ainda tem uma participação inédita no filme “Vingadores: Doutor Destino”, que estreia em dezembro de 2026.

Ao longo da carreira, Patrick Stewart acumulou prêmios. Em 1996, ganhou uma estrela na Calçada da Fama de Hollywood. Na TV, foram oito indicações ao Emmy, conhecido como o Oscar da televisão, e ao Globo de Ouro, por trabalhos como “Moby Dick”, “O Leão no Inverno” e ‘Hamlet”.

Em 2010, recebeu um dos maiores reconhecimentos dados a civis no Reino Unido: recebeu da Rainha Elizabeth II o título de cavaleiro. E o astro que uma vez foi chamado de “ator desconhecido de estilo shakespeariano” ficou reconhecido no mundo como Sir. Patrick Stewart e, em galáxias distantes, como o eterno capitão Jean-Luc Picard.

articles.title: Dia do Livro: Ecoteca une leitura e educação ambiental em parque no AC | G1
articles.standfirst: Iniciativa funciona no Horto Florestal, em Rio Branco. Dia Nacional do Livro é celebrado nesta quinta-feira (29).
articles.summary: Iniciativa funciona no Horto Florestal, em Rio Branco. Dia Nacional do Livro é celebrado nesta quinta-feira (29).
articles.body:
Um espaço que convida a desacelerar e une leitura a educação ambiental funciona dentro do Horto Florestal, em Rio Branco . A ecoteca é uma iniciativa que mostra que o contato pode ir além das páginas dos livros e incentiva a curiosidade, o aprendizado e a formação de novos leitores.

📚📖 Nesta quinta-feira (29) é celebrado o Dia Nacional do Livro. A data marca a fundação da Biblioteca Nacional e busca incentivar a leitura, além de destacar a importância dos livros para preservar ideias, descobertas, experiências e transmitir conhecimentos.

Segundo a educadora ambiental Samaira Freiras, a ecoteca do Horto Florestal é uma espaço que, por estar em meio à natureza, convida as pessoas a desacelerar, descobrir novas histórias e a aprender coisas novas.

O local funciona de segunda a sexta-feira, com uma programação diversificada. A educadora detalha também que o espaço reúne livros e experiências que aproximam os visitantes da leitura e despertam o interesse pelo meio ambiente.

“Aqui na Ecoteca, diariamente, nós atendemos tanto a comunidade como as instituições de educação infantil e do ensino fundamental. Nós temos várias propostas voltadas a essa comunidade, na qual nós recebemos as crianças. Temos os acervos literários voltados para temáticas ambientais para fortalecer o vínculo das crianças com as temáticas ambientais, que são muito importantes”, afirmou.

Ecoteca une leitura e educação ambiental em parque no Acre — Foto: Lucas Brito/Prefeitura de Rio Branco

A coordenadora pedagógica da escola Djanira Bezerra dos Reis, Neiva Nara de Araújo, levou os alunos para conhecer a ecoteca. Segundo ela, para as crianças, o contato com as histórias contribui para o desenvolvimento da imaginação, da criatividade e da linguagem.

“A educação infantil é muito lúdica, então esse contato das crianças com a literatura, com a cultura, com o meio ambiente, é de suma importância. Por isso procuramos trazer as nossas crianças, tirar um pouco da sala de aula para eles conhecerem algo que é novo para eles. E aqui no Horto, temos essa oportunidade de misturar ludicidade, brincadeira, contação de história e meio ambiente. Como eles são crianças, acreditamos que é o pilar. Se eles aprenderem hoje, mesmo que de forma lúdica, a preservar o meio ambiente, a cuidar da natureza, eles serão adultos muito mais conscientes”, defendeu.

Dia Nacional do Livro é celebrado nesta quinta-feira (29) — Foto: Getty Images

Segundo Samaira, a leitura permite que o leitor viaje por diferentes locais sem que seja necessário sair do lugar. Conforme a educadora, parte do acervo da ecoteca é de uma literatura que promove consciência ambiental e também atitudes de cuidado com o espaço em que cada um vive.

“Quando elas vão para a visita orientada, saem daqui com um olhar. E quando voltam, trazem aquela empolgação, com cuidado com o meio ambiente, que vão conversar com o papai e com a mamãe. [...] Então, é nessa faixa etária que começamos a fazer esse trabalho para que realmente as crianças se conscientizem desde a infância e possam conscientizar os adultos também”, finalizou.

articles.title: India-EU landmark FTA likely rollout in mid-2027, says top EU lawmaker
articles.summary: The European Parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee Chair, David McAllister, has said that the India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is expected to be
articles.body: The European Parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee Chair, David McAllister, has said that the India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is expected to be signed by mid-December 2026, with PM Narendra Modi anticipated to travel to Brussels for the official signing ceremony.The "mother of all deals" will still undergo rigorous scrutiny by the European Parliament, but McAllister told TOI in an interview he's confident about smooth ratification, given the benefits it will bring to both sides. The EU lawmaker said that a consent vote is expected by spring next year, paving the way for the trade agreement to officially enter into force mid-2027."We expect the FTA to be signed by mid-December. Hopefully, PM Modi will manage to visit Brussels and attend the official signing ceremony," said McAllister, who led an EU Parliamentary delegation to India this week."Though Parliament cannot amend the text of the agreement, our consent is required before it enters into force. I followed the debate in the European Parliament over the past months, and I can say there seems to be a broad majority support for this landmark FTA. The benefits for both sides are so huge that I'm sure the European Parliament will give its support in the consent vote," added McAllister, who heads the Parliamentary committee that shapes and monitors the EU's common foreign and security policy.McAllister also said the EU would particularly welcome progress on the investment protection agreement as it would strengthen the confidence of European investors in the Indian market, encouraging greater European investments and contributing to job creation in India. He said the FTA would allow India and the EU to work more closely on de-risking supply chains and reducing dependencies.If the FTA indeed is ready for signing by mid-December, Modi is likely to stop over in Brussels to ink the deal on his way back to India from the US G20 summit. The PM will also travel to Canada and possibly to Germany during that trip.Asked about the prospects of defence-industrial collaboration and technology sharing under the new India-EU defence and security partnership, McAllister backed closer cooperation between India and the European defence industry, saying it is in the interest of both sides. He also spoke about the convergence of interest in keeping the Indo-Pacific free and open and the need to reduce reliance on any one country"There are many fields of cooperation in this matter. I would definitely mention information sharing, research cooperation and cybersecurity. One element would be that we also invite India to participate in a closer cooperation with our European defense industry, because here we also have a joint interest," said the lawmaker."We in Europe, as part of our strategic sovereignty, want to reduce the dependence on one particular country, and I understand that the debate in India is very similar. You also want to step-by-step reduce your dependence, and I think this is a very good win-win situation for both sides," said McAllister.Asked about India's position on the Russia-Ukraine war, McAllister welcomed the Modi government's diplomatic efforts to achieve a ceasefire covering energy infrastructure, Black Sea shipping, and the movement of grain."Any peace agreement must be just, sustainable and acceptable to both sides. It must also include absolute, concrete security guarantees for Ukraine that Putin (Russian president) is not able to repeat this unbelievable act of aggression and violation of international law. So, if India with its special relationship with Russia - and also India with its constructive relationship with Ukraine - can play any kind of role constructively, it would be welcome," he said, while praising Jaishankar's "constructive" role for peace.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Cockroach in masala dosa? Bengaluru’s iconic restaurant faces food hygiene heat
articles.summary: Cockroach allegedly found in masala dosa at Bengaluru’s CTR sparks hygiene concerns; viral video prompts apology and kitchen inspection pledge by restaurant.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Everyone’s favourite dosa spot in Bengaluru, including Virat Kohli’s, Central Tiffin Room, popularly known as CTR, was recently in the news — not for its crispy dosas, but for a cockroach that was allegedly found inside one.In a video posted on Instagram earlier this week, a customer alleged that a cockroach was found inside a masala dosa they had ordered at CTR’s Malleswaram outlet. The video showed the cockroach inside the dosa, along with the customer’s conversations with the restaurant’s staff.The customer also alleged that when they raised a complaint with the staff, they were offered another masala dosa. “Management offers change in dosa instead of change in kitchen hygiene,” the video said. In the accompanying caption, they added, “We expected better from an establishment with such a legacy. Food safety should never be compromised, no matter how big the name is.”CTR, also known as Shri Sagar, operates two outlets in Bengaluru — one on Margosa Road in Malleswaram, which has been around since 1920, and another on the premises of Kempegowda International Airport (KIA), which was inaugurated in 2024. The restaurant is famous for its crispy dosas, goli baje, chow chow bath and other South Indian dishes.The video, posted by an Instagram user named ‘trustedcircleblr’, garnered over 6.6 lakh views in two days, with several other users sharing their own experiences in the comments section. One user even alleged that they had once received a dosa with ants in the batter. Some, however, defended the restaurant, arguing that such “minor lapses” could occur even in household kitchens and that the establishment should not be judged too harshly.The online discussion prompted the restaurant to acknowledge the incident. In an apology posted on Instagram, the restaurant said, “There are no excuses for this; food safety and hygiene are non-negotiable for us, and we have taken immediate and rigorous steps to inspect our kitchen and ensure this never happens again.”The customer who posted the complaint video also responded to the restaurant’s apology, saying they hope to see “these positive words” translated into practical action across all its outlets.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Bengaluru | Silver Rate in Bengaluru | Bank Holidays in Bengaluru | Public Holidays in Bengaluru | Bengaluru AQI | Weather in Bengaluru | Petrol Price in Bengaluru | Diesel Price in Bengaluru | CNG Price in Bengaluru | LPG Price in BengaluruStay updated with the latest Bengaluru news. articles.title: Woman Accused of Killing American Man at Beachside Condo Is Arrested After Weeks on the Run
articles.summary: Authorities allege the woman met the 74-year-old victim online before an argument at his condo turned deadly
articles.body:
Costa Rican authorities say a woman has been arrested in connection with the death of a 74-year-old American tourist

Marc Walter Fleming, 74, was found dead at a condo in Playas del Coco on Sept. 27

Authorities allege the woman arrested in Fleming's death had met him online earlier and got into an argument with him at his condo, culminating in an altercation that led to his death

Costa Rican authorities have arrested a woman in connection with the death of 74-year-old American tourist Marc Walter Fleming late last month.

Fleming was found dead on the afternoon of Sunday, Sept. 27 at a condo unit in Playas del Coco, located in Sardinal, Guanacaste, according to a press release earlier this month from the Liberia Regional Office of the Judicial Investigation Department.

Investigators with the department also posted security camera footage on social media showing a woman in a bikini walking to and from a vehicle alongside another woman in a pink dress. Officials alleged the woman in the bikini was suspected of being involved in Fleming's homicide and asked the public for help identifying her.

Costa Rican authorities alleged that Fleming had "apparently entered a condominium accompanied by the woman in question, who later left the premises," according to an English translation of the Costa Rican Judicial Investigation Agency (OIJ) press release.

"When the man's body was discovered, it bore head injuries that appeared to have been inflicted by a blunt object," authorities added.

Fox News reported this week that the woman was arrested on Tuesday, citing information from the OIJ office.

OIJ Deputy Director Vladimir Muñoz reportedly told the outlet that the woman – identified only as "Ortiz" – is alleged to have met Fleming online and later had gone to his condo after he picked her up in his car. At his condo, the two allegedly got into an argument, according to Fox News.

Muñoz reportedly alleged that the suspect then hit Fleming over the head, leading to his death. She is also accused of stealing his bank cards, according to the outlet.

According to Fox News , the other woman in the pink dress seen with Ortiz on the day of Fleming's alleged murder has also been arrested.

PEOPLE has reached out to the OIJ for more information but did not receive an immediate response on Thursday.

articles.title: Asked for extra serving of chole, Delhi man stabbed to death by vendor
articles.summary: Delhi’s Nihal Vihar: Driver Sandeep, 35, fatally stabbed by chole-bhature vendor after dispute over extra chole; accused arrested, FIR amended under BNS 103.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: A dispute over an extra serving of chole allegedly turned fatal after a roadside food vendor stabbed a 35-year-old man to death in outer Delhi’s Nihal Vihar, police said.The victim, Sandeep, who worked as a driver, is survived by his wife and two children.According to police, the incident took place Sunday night near Jwalapuri Nala, where Sandeep had ordered a plate of chole-bhature from a roadside stall run by Chintu Gupta. An argument allegedly broke out after Sandeep asked for additional chole and Gupta refused. The disagreement escalated into a physical altercation.Police alleged that Gupta then pulled out a knife from his cart and stabbed Sandeep multiple times.The injured man was initially taken to Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital, where a medico-legal case was registered. Doctors recorded three stab wounds on the left side of his abdomen, three lacerated injuries on his left forearm and another injury on his wrist.Based on the MLC and statements of eyewitnesses, police registered a case and launched an investigation.Sandeep was later shifted to Maharaja Agrasen Hospital in Punjabi Bagh, where he succumbed to his injuries Tuesday.A senior police officer said the victim’s family initially suspected that four to five people had attacked him, but the claim was not supported by eyewitness accounts.The accused, Chintu Gupta, a resident of Nihal Vihar, was arrested and later remanded to judicial custody.The FIR, initially registered under provisions relating to attempt to murder, was amended to include Section 103 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) after the victim’s death. articles.title: Diljit Dosanjh concert: Delhi Metro services extended, traffic curbs around JLN Stadium
articles.summary: DMRC to run extra metro trips and extend services after Diljit Dosanjh’s Aura India Tour 2026 concert at JLN Stadium; added staff, security.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: To facilitate the movement of spectators attending “Aura India Tour 2026” concert by renowned artiste Diljit Dosanjh at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium Friday, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) has made special operational arrangements, including the extension of services beyond normal operating hours on all lines (except Airport Express Line and Rapid Metro, Gurgaon).“Additional train trips will be operated across the network to facilitate the smooth dispersal of spectators after the event. Standby trains will also be kept ready for deployment, if required, to cater to any unforeseen surge in passenger traffic. In addition, the timings for QR ticket purchase on Delhi Metro Sarthi App shall also be increased by an hour owing to extended service timings on the day,” said Anuj Dayal, principal executive director, corporate communications, DMRC.Additional DMRC staff, customer service personnel and customer facilitation agents will be deployed to guide commuters and regulate passenger movement.The concert is expected to attract approximately 70,000 spectators, many of whom are likely to use metro services for travelling. JLN Stadium metro station on the Violet Line is the nearest station to the venue.Traffic restrictions will be enforced on several roads around Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium on Friday in view of singer Diljit Dosanjh's concert, police said.The restrictions will remain in force from 1 pm until midnight for the 'Aura India Tour 2026' concert. Six diversion points have been identified, with two additional points to be activated if required, according to an advisory issued by the Delhi Traffic Police.Bhishm Pitamah Marg, Lodhi Road, Lala Lajpat Rai Marg between Defence Colony and Lodhi Colony Flyover, Arch Bishop Marg, 4th Avenue Road and 5th Avenue Road are among the stretches where traffic movement will be affected, the advisory stated.Restrictions will also be imposed on the Barapullah Flyover stretch between INA and Jangpura Metro Gate 2, Dayal Singh College Road, and internal roads in CGO Complex and Lodhi Colony.At the Lodhi Road-Dayal Singh College Road intersection, vehicles will not be allowed to enter Dayal Singh College Road. Traffic on Lodhi Road will continue towards Lodhi Flyover or Aurobindo Marg. Diversions will also be enforced at intersections along Lala Lajpat Rai Marg and Bhishm Pitamah Marg to regulate traffic movement towards the stadium.The traffic police have advised concert-goers to use the Metro to reach the venue. JLN Stadium and Jangpura stations on the Violet Line will provide access to Gates 13, 14 and 17. INA and Jor Bagh stations on the Yellow Line can be used to reach the designated drop-off points for Gates 3, 6 and 8.No public parking will be available at or around the venue. Invitees can park at Sunehri Pula Bus Depot and Dayal Singh College, while taxis and auto-rickshaws must use designated pick-up and drop-off points.Commuters have been advised to allow extra travel time, follow instructions issued by traffic personnel and avoid roadside parking near the stadium.(With Agency Inputs)You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Delhi | Silver Rate in Delhi | Bank Holidays in Delhi | Public Holidays in Delhi | Delhi AQI | Weather in Delhi | Petrol Price in Delhi | Diesel Price in Delhi | CNG Price in Delhi | LPG Price in DelhiStay updated with the latest Delhi news. articles.title: '1st we lost our land, now compensation': Money from PNB’s Greater Noida branch accounts diverted to 6 accounts in Goa, Mumbai, Jharkhand
articles.summary: PNB Greater Noida fraud probe: Rs 35 crore allegedly diverted to six accounts in Goa, Mumbai, Jharkhand; 30 complaints cite emptied accounts and locker theft.
articles.body: 30 complaints received, many claim gold & silver in locker replaced with faux jewelleryNOIDA: Money allegedly diverted from customers’ accounts at a Punjab National Bank (PNB) branch in Greater Noida reached six bank accounts in Goa, Mumbai and Jharkhand, police have found in their investigation into alleged embezzlement of Rs 35 crore from the branch. Police have frozen the accounts.The police cybercrime team and PNB’s vigilance team, investigating the alleged fraud, said the money didn’t stay in these accounts and have been routed to others. Investigators suspect that branch employees and the bank manager may have come into contact with a cyberfraud gang and allegedly facilitated the irregularities.So far, 30 account holders from Aichhar, Birondi, Bironda, Kyampur and several other neighbouring villages have submitted complaints at Beta 2 police station. The SHO said 12 fresh complaints were filed on Thursday and all the complaints were being clubbed into an FIR filed earlier under BNS Section 316(5) (criminal breach of trust) against the PNB branch staffers.The FIR was lodged on Wednesday after Shrichand, a resident of Viroondi Chakrasenpur village in Surajpur, alleged that Rs 1.16 crore was embezzled from his FD linked to his account at the Aichhar branch.On Thursday, several account holders staged a protest outside the Aichhar branch, with several claiming that gold and silver jewellery and other valuables have gone missing from lockers too. In some cases, these have been replaced with faux ornaments.Some accused bank officials of altering registered mobile numbers and email IDs before diverting money from fixed deposits (FDs) and savings accounts to ensure that account holders did not receive transaction alerts. Many complainants, most of them farmers who had received land compensation from Noida Authority, said their accounts were completely emptied out by the bank staff.Ajipal, a resident of Birondi village, told TOI that he received compensation after his family’s land was acquired in 2001 and rented a locker at the bank in 2014. He said he learnt of the alleged fraud on Oct 27 and approached the bank for details on a Rs 35.34 lakh fixed deposit (FD) and 18 tolas (approximately 210 grams) of gold and 1 kg of silver jewellery in his locker, but the bank manager did not give a clear response. He alleged that the mobile number and email ID registered against his account did not match his actual contact details and may have been deliberately changed to stop him from receiving alerts about unauthorised transactions.“On Thursday, bank staffers were asking affected customers to submit affidavits detailing the money held in their fixed deposits (FDs) and the gold and silver jewellery kept in their lockers,” Ajipal said. While the process is meant to document their claims, several account holders said they were still awaiting clear answers about the status of their money and jewellery.‘First we lost our land & now our compensation’Santosh, a resident from Birondi village, alleged that Rs 1.3 crore had been deposited in her bank account as land acquisition compensation, of which Rs 1.2 crore had allegedly gone missing. Expressing anguish over the alleged loss, she said her family had already lost its land to acquisition and had deposited the compensation money in the bank with the expectation that it would secure their future. “First, they took our land, and now the bank has taken away our compensation money,” she said.Meanwhile, senior bank officials from Mumbai and Noida, who have been called in to monitor the case, told TOI that audits have been ordered at other branches in Gautam Budh Nagar where land acquisition compensation was deposited over the past two years. Rajesh Bhowmik, the bank’s zonal manager, said a case had been registered with the CBI. Money of three account holders has been credited to their accounts, he said. “…three claims amounting to Rs 43 lakh had been settled as of yesterday (Wednesday). The bank assures its customers that all genuine claims will be honoured,” PNB said in a statement.On Wednesday, PNB suspended the branch manager and four other employees. Bhowmik said the bank will examine each account holder’s case individually before refunding the amounts.“PNB has taken serious cognisance of the complaints regarding alleged financial irregularities involving certain customer fixed/ savings bank deposit accounts at its Greater Noida branch. articles.title: NY enacts ban on 'unsafe' chatbot with kids as states push AI regulation boundaries
articles.summary: New York is enacting far-reaching curbs on companion chatbot behaviour, as states increasingly move to protect children who use artificial intelligence,
articles.body: New York is enacting far-reaching curbs on companion chatbot behaviour, as states increasingly move to protect children who use artificial intelligence, regulate how employers deploy AI systems and push developers to prevent an AI-caused catastrophe.Legislation signed Wednesday by governor Kathy Hochul outlines a dozen definitions of "unsafe AI companion features" that will be prohibited when a companion chatbot interacts with a child under 18.A violation could expose a chatbot developer to a lawsuit by the state attorney general's office. Penalties could include monetary damages, shutting down the chatbot and destroying data. The law takes effect Jan 1. Hochul, in the thick of her reelection campaign, signed the bill amid growing warnings about the existential risks posed by the rapid development of AI technology and calls for bold action by a reluctant Washington.With the US Congress doing little to regulate AI, state legislatures are packed with efforts to wield state consumer protection laws to make AI use more transparent and rein in chatbots and rogue AI frontier models.In Sept, California governor Gavin Newsom signed legislation requiring chatbot developers to assess a model's risk to children, show how they tried to eliminate those risks and submit to an independent audit to determine whether they are complying with the law. He also signed legislation to prohibit social media platforms from deploying addictive features for users under 16.Meanwhile, eight states sued AI giant OpenAI earlier this month, saying the company's popular chatbot model violated state consumer protection laws by hurting children and deceiving adults.However, governors acknowledge that Congress and the federal govt have far-reaching abilities to clamp down on AI-posed threats, even as President Trump has brushed off concerns and warned states not to regulate AI.Under New York's law, outlawed chatbot behaviour with children under 18 includes suggestions that the chatbot is a real person who has emotions, opinions or an actual relationship with the child. It also outlaws chatbot messages that use flattery, involve sexually explicit material or encourage secrecy or unhealthy behaviour.Jim Steyer, founder and CEO of watchdog group Common Sense Media, called New York's law "the strongest kids' AI safety bill in the country".Justine Gluck, policy analyst at the Future of Privacy Forum, a nonprofit focused on data protection and AI governance, said the different regulatory approaches by California and New York could be models other states adopt after legislatures reconvene next year.New York's law, she said, underscores how quickly chatbot regulation is evolving. Still, several categories in New York's law are broadly worded or undefined, Gluck said. That raises questions, she said, about "where ordinary conversational responsiveness ends and prohibited behaviour begins," and could complicate how it is enforced.You use AI every day. articles.title: 'Nvidia chief seen as target of China spy plot'
articles.summary: A top executive at a Singapore-based data centre company, Megaspeed, was under scrutiny for possibly steering advanced Nvidia AI chips to China, according
articles.body: A top executive at a Singapore-based data centre company, Megaspeed, was under scrutiny for possibly steering advanced Nvidia AI chips to China, according to a report in New York Times. American officials had concluded that she was a Chinese intelligence asset, sending information to Beijing.The report claims that surveillance of the executive, Alice Huang or Huang Le, a Chinese citizen, revealed that she had developed a close relationship with Jensen Huang, Nvidia's chief executive.In a startling revelation, the report says President Trump was briefed about the intelligence findings but chose not to do anything. He has been wary of disrupting Nvidia's chip sales, which are helping to drive the economy and the stock market, and of further complicating the trading relationship with China.Washington has been working to deny China the technology needed to match or surpass US in AI. The discovery that Beijing was getting reports from someone with direct access to Jensen Huang, who is also an ally of President Trump, had set off alarm bells ringing at White House.Nvidia's chief executive has successfully lobbied the administration during Trump's second term to roll back tighter restrictions on the sales of the company's chips to China. He also negotiated a deal with Trump that allowed US govt to take a 25% stake of certain Nvidia chips that govt allows to be sold to China.When the Trump administration was considering a ban on sales of Nvidia chips to China, Huang and his wife travelled to Mar-a-Lago to convince Trump to allow chip companies to do business with Beijing.Nvidia later donated at least $20 million to Trump's ballroom fund, a person with knowledge of the matter said. The company also pledged to invest $500 billion on manufacturing in US.The account of Alice Huang's activities is based on interviews with people briefed on the surveillance, who spoke on the condition of anonymity. The surveillance of Alice Huang continues, they said, and companies that have been affiliated with her continued to buy Nvidia chips this year.Nvidia said it had previously debunked claims that Megaspeed was smuggling chips to China. John Rizzo, a spokesman for Nvidia, added that customers like Megaspeed "receive ordinary business information - not sensitive Nvidia trade secrets - and zero information relevant to national security". Megaspeed is among the companies that buy chips to build data centres and then rent their computing power to companies in China.White House, CIA and National Security Agency declined to comment. Alice Huang did not respond to requests for comment. In a statement to NYT, Megaspeed said its "current leadership" takes the matter "extremely seriously and is committed to getting to the facts behind allegations". articles.title: Why this 50-year-old Italian man walked nearly 1,000 kilometres alone on the Camino de Santiago despite having to carry his own food because of coeliac disease
articles.summary: Walking the Camino de Santiago alone with coeliac disease left Marco Degl’Innocenti, a 50-year-old box factory employee and keen trekker from the Italian
articles.body: Walking the Camino de Santiago alone with coeliac disease left Marco Degl’Innocenti, a 50-year-old box factory employee and keen trekker from the Italian town of Empoli, carrying his own gluten-free food across nearly 1,000 kilometres. He began at Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port on the French side of the Pyrenees, following the most famous, ancient and frequented route to Santiago de Compostela entirely on his own, setting off on 26 July and returning home on 23 August after his employer granted him a month’s leave. His wife Martina then joined him in Santiago to cover a further 100 kilometres together towards Muxia and Finisterre.A painful fall during a hike turned into a promise to walk to Santiago once he turned fiftyDegl’Innocenti told La Nazione that the idea took shape after he fell badly during an excursion and hurt himself. Once he had recovered, he decided the pilgrimage would happen when his fiftieth birthday came round. His friends from the amateur football team 4 Mori backed the plan with a celebratory shirt, which he wore in his moments of relaxation and which drew plenty of interest and amusement from other pilgrims.Foot cream, a poncho and painkillers shared the rucksack with food he could not count on findingDegl’Innocenti said his rucksack held a hat, sunglasses and moisturising cream, which he massaged into his feet before each departure. It also contained technical walking gear, a poncho for the rain and some painkillers, because blisters and knee trouble are normal, especially in the first days. Then came the food. In some stretches, he said, food suitable for coeliacs was practically impossible to find, so he had to bring it with him.Early starts, afternoon sightseeing and a daily photo for friends at home shaped each dayDegl’Innocenti usually set off at about 6.45 and aimed to reach the next stop in the early afternoon, which left time to visit its most characteristic places. He covered the route in twenty-nine stages, fewer than the usual thirty to thirty-five. For company, he and his friends had created a WhatsApp group, where he sent a photo every day, and they exchanged a couple of jokes. It felt, he said, as though they were with him the whole way.A rain-soaked climb into Spain was the hardest day, while Rioja’s sunflower fields stole the showThe first stage, which crosses into Spain, was also the hardest, Degl’Innocenti said, because of a height difference of 1,200 metres and a downpour that accompanied him. From there, the route is marked with yellow paint arrows, something he credited to the historic parish priest of Cebreiro, Elias Valiña.Asked for the loveliest stretch, he pointed to the Rioja region, with its endless sunflower fields, red earth and low vines. He also praised the city of Burgos, the fountain of water and wine at Irache and the grandeur of the cathedral in Santiago.Walking alone became therapy as grief surfaced, with tears in the final stretch before CompostelaGiving up never crossed his mind. Physically, he felt well throughout and kept a good pace. Walking alone, he said, is therapeutic because it lets you reflect on many things. For him that included a bereavement. He cried a great deal along the way, especially over the last kilometres before reaching Compostela, when he told himself that he had made it.Running to his wife, quieting a snoring pilgrim and joking about the North Cape for next timeReunited with his wife, the first thing Degl’Innocenti did was drop his rucksack and run towards her with open arms.Along the way, he helped a woman who was struggling to breathe. One night in a hostel, he used gestures to persuade a Chinese pilgrim, whose snoring was keeping the whole dormitory awake, to turn onto his side. The next morning, the other occupants thanked him.He would do it all again, he told La Nazione, partly for the chance to meet people from other countries and swap opinions and experiences. As for the next adventure, he joked with his cousins that if a sponsor turns up, he will head for the North Cape.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Jamia set to hold student body polls after 22 years; 18-day hunger strike ends
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: After over two decades without an elected students' union, Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) is set to return to campus democracy, with the university
articles.body: NEW DELHI: After over two decades without an elected students' union, Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) is set to return to campus democracy, with the university committing to complete the union constitution by May 15, 2027, and hold elections by Aug 27, 2027. The last union election was held in 2005, reports Sugandha Jha.The breakthrough came late Thursday after registrar Md Mahtab Alam Rizvi visited the protest site around 9pm and held talks with the agitating students, bringing the 18-day hunger strike to an end on the university's 106th Foundation Day. The registrar's order, issued after the discussions, addressed the protesters' central demand for a time-bound roadmap to restore elected student representation. It also directed the withdrawal of disciplinary action linked to the stir.Polls at Jamia likely in Aug next year, 18-day hunger strike endsThe five hunger strikers ended their fast with juice offered by the registrar. Celebrations broke out at the protest site after the order to complete union polls and constitution was issued.The order stated: “The approval and implementation of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union Constitution shall be completed by May 15, 2027. Subsequent to the approval of the Constitution, the university shall release the notification for elections in accordance with the recommendations and guidelines of the Lyngdoh Committee. This date will be in accordance with the guidelines set forth by the Lyngdoh Committee regulations. The elections shall be conducted within six weeks of the start of the academic session, i.e., approximately within six weeks from July 16, 2027.”On disciplinary proceedings, the administration directed: “All ongoing show-causes notices, disciplinary actions, rustications, suspensions and campus ban orders issued in connection with participation in the protest period shall be revoked.”“In view of the above, the protesting students shall call off their hunger strike with immediate effect,” it added.The resolution came on a day when JMI’s customary Foundation Day celebrations were curtailed amid the agitation. Instead of the usual programme, the official observance was limited to flag hoisting and the university anthem, while protesting students organised an ‘Inquilabi Mela’ at Gulistan-e-Ghalib near Gate No. 7. Hunger strikers Ebin Basil and Rehan Khan were designated ‘chief guests’ at the parallel event, which featured speeches and the release of a protest report and memorandum.Jamia traditionally marks its foundation day with weeklong celebrations attended by prominent dignitaries. Last year, Union minister Kiren Rijiju was the chief guest. This year, the agitation overshadowed the occasion, turning it into a platform for students to press for democratic representation.How the standoff escalatedThe agitation began on Oct 12, with students demanding the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students’ Union (JMISU), which has remained defunct since 2006. On Oct 24, the administration issued an order accepting the protesters’ demands and stating elections would be held within 15 days of approval of the students’ union constitution after the agitation grew bigger and gained support from political figures. However, the order did not specify a deadline for completing the constitution, leaving a key procedural step open-ended and failing to address the protesters’ demand for a time-bound roadmap.The movement intensified as five students — Ebin Basil, Rehan Khan, Ritik, Altaf and Abuzar — began an indefinite hunger strike. Their demands also included the release of students in police custody and Tihar Jail, withdrawal of show-cause notices issued to female students, and removal of the chief proctor and security adviser.The standoff subsequently saw clashes between students and security personnel, increased security deployment, restrictions on campus gatherings and a shift to online classes. Protesters also faced disciplinary proceedings, campus-ban orders and directions for some students to leave the campus. The university is now expected to resume physical classes soon.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Delhi | Silver Rate in Delhi | Bank Holidays in Delhi | Public Holidays in Delhi | Delhi AQI | Weather in Delhi | Petrol Price in Delhi | Diesel Price in Delhi | CNG Price in Delhi | LPG Price in DelhiStay updated with the latest Delhi news. articles.title: Glacial lake outburst in Bhutan: North Bengal on red alert as flood threat looms; thousands evacuated
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Parts of West Bengal and Assam were placed on high alert after a glacial lake outburst in Bhutan triggered a flash flood, raising fears of a
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Parts of West Bengal and Assam were placed on high alert after a glacial lake outburst in Bhutan triggered a flash flood, raising fears of a sudden rise in water levels along the Sankosh river. More than 10,000 people have been moved to relief shelters and safer locations in West Bengal, while authorities in Assam's Dhubri district have stepped up preparedness to deal with possible downstream effects.The outburst sent large volumes of water downstream through the Mo Chhu river towards the Sankosh river system, prompting authorities to activate disaster response mechanisms in vulnerable areas.The flood washed away infrastructure at the Gasa Tshachu natural hot springs in Bhutan's Gasa district. No injuries or loss of life have been reported, state broadcaster Bhutan Broadcasting Service (BBS) said on Friday.The full extent of the damage from the late-night flood remained unclear. BBS said the assessment was hampered by “darkness and the strong flow” of floodwaters. Two Bailey bridges, constructed using portable, prefabricated sections, may also have been washed away.According to Bhutan's national newspaper Kuensel, parts of the road leading to Laya village, where the hot springs are located, were washed away, making the route impassable. The road has been closed to traffic indefinitely. The area was evacuated before the floodwaters reached the hot springs.West Bengal shifts thousands to safetyAuthorities in West Bengal have alerted residents living along the Sankosh river and its tributaries following reports of the glacial lake outburst flood in Bhutan.Residents in the Darjeeling hills, Terai and Dooars regions have also been advised to remain alert and move to safer locations if they live in vulnerable areas.BJP MP from Darjeeling Raju Bista issued an alert through a post on X on Thursday, urging people living in the catchment areas of the Sankosh river and its connected tributaries to move to safer locations."A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) has been reported at Lemthang in Bhutan. The overflowing water from the lake is flowing downwards through the Mofu River towards the Sunkosh River," the post read."Therefore, everyone living in the catchment areas of the Sunkosh River and all its connected tributaries have been informed to move to a safe distance immediately to protect their lives. Everyone in our Darjeeling hills, Terai and Dooars region are requested to stay alert," he added.State minister Nisith Pramanik said the government had received reports of the glacial lake outburst and that the overflowing water was moving towards the Sankosh river through the Mo Chhu river."Reports have just come in regarding a glacial lake outburst in Bhutan. Water from the lake is overflowing and flowing downstream into the Mo Chhu River, heading toward the Sankosh River. Residents living along the Sankosh River and its tributaries have been alerted; they are advised to move to a safe distance immediately to ensure their safety," Pramanik said.He said the water was expected to reach the plains within five to six hours, raising concerns about possible flooding."To manage the situation, the State Disaster Management Team has been activated, and the NDRF has also been notified. Disaster management volunteers have been instructed to be present on-site. The government is taking proactive measures and closely monitoring the situation to prevent any loss of life or property," he added.Alipurduar Superintendent of Police Amit Kumar Shaw appealed to residents not to panic, saying the administration was coordinating with Bhutanese authorities and disaster response agencies."First of all, I would like to tell the residents of the district that there is absolutely no need to panic. The situation is currently under control. We are in constant touch with the authorities in Bhutan. Our police team, the District Magistrate (DM) and the Block Development Officer (BDO) with their respective teams, along with all relevant agencies and stakeholders, are working together in close coordination," Shaw told ANI.He said the State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) had been deployed in the area, while a National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) team was also on its way. Civil Defence personnel had additionally been mobilised to assist with preparedness measures."We have already moved approximately 4,000 to 5,000 people into shelters, utilising school buildings as relief centres. Additionally, more than 6,000 people have been relocated to safe areas," he said.Shaw said the intensity of the water flow had decreased slightly, according to the latest information received, but the administration remained on high alert."The police, the DM's office, and the BDO's office have made arrangements for dry food and drinking water. We have also ensured that other necessities, such as toilet facilities, are provided. We will wait to see what the situation looks like in two hours. We are fully prepared and ready to handle any emergency that may arise," he said.He added that a red alert was in force for the Sankosh river system and warned that the approaching floodwaters could carry dead fish and debris, including large pieces of wood and concrete."We expect to see water flowing through the Sankosh River, likely accompanied by dead fish, as well as large pieces of wood and concrete debris," Shaw said.Assam monitors possible impact in DhubriMeanwhile, the Assam government said it was closely monitoring the situation following the glacial lake outburst in Bhutan, with Dhubri district placed on alert over possible downstream effects.The Sankosh river flows through Dhubri district, and authorities have stepped up vigilance amid the possibility of a sudden rise in water levels."The situation arising out of the Glacial Lake Outburst Flood in Bhutan is being closely monitored by HCM Dr @himantabiswa," the Chief Minister's Office said in a social media post."Team @dcofficedhubri is on ground and prepared to effectively deal with the downstream effects," it added.An Assam State Disaster Management Authority spokesperson said the water level of the Sankosh river was steady as of 6.30 am on Friday. The district administration and disaster response teams were on alert to tackle any eventuality.A special advisory issued by the ministry of Jal Shakti on Thursday for Assam and West Bengal said the Indian Embassy had reported a GLOF in Shintaphu Lake, located in Bhutan's Punatsangchhu river basin.Following reports of flash floods in the river's upper reaches, water levels in the Sankosh river could rise suddenly in Assam's Dhubri and West Bengal's Alipurduar districts, the advisory said.Local authorities in both districts were advised to remain alert, closely monitor the situation and take necessary precautionary measures.What is a glacial lake outburst flood?A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF), also known as a jokulhlaup, occurs when the natural dam holding back a glacial lake fails or is breached, releasing large volumes of water downstream.Such floods can cause sudden destruction of roads, bridges, settlements and other infrastructure, particularly in mountainous regions.Shintaphu Lake, located below Wakila Mountain in Lungo, Laya Gewog, in Bhutan's Gasa district, is among 17 glacial lakes in the country identified as potentially dangerous, according to local reports.Gasa Tshachu, a popular natural hot spring in northern Bhutan, was also hit by a flash flood in 2021 when the Mochhu river changed course and swept through the area.The latest incident has renewed concerns over glacial lake outburst floods in the Himalayan region. In August, a flash flood near Nepal's border with China killed more than 1,500 people and left over 5,000 missing, according to the supplied report.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Poverty plunges in India, but top 10% earn 13 times more than bottom 10%: World Bank
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: India has lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023, recording one of the world's fastest declines in poverty
articles.body: NEW DELHI: India has lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023, recording one of the world's fastest declines in poverty over the period. However, significant income inequality persists, with workers in the country's top 10% earning a median income nearly 13 times higher than those in the bottom 10%, according to the World Bank's October 2026 India Poverty and Equity Brief.The report highlights India's progress in reducing both extreme and multidimensional poverty but flags persistent challenges such as stagnant real wages, poor employment quality and unequal access to economic opportunities.Sharp decline in povertyThe share of India's population living below the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day, measured at 2021 purchasing power parity (PPP), fell sharply from 57.7% in 2011 to 16.1% in 2023.Extreme poverty also witnessed a significant decline. The proportion of people living on less than $3 a day dropped from 27.1% to 2.6% during the same period.Rural poverty remains higherDespite the overall progress, poverty remains unevenly distributed across the country. Rural poverty stood at 19.3% in 2023, significantly higher than the 8.6% recorded in urban areas, based on the $4.20-a-day threshold.The report noted that households with lower educational attainment, fewer assets, limited access to stable employment and higher dependency ratios remain particularly vulnerable.Geographically, states across a contiguous belt stretching from Uttar Pradesh to West Bengal accounted for around 57% of India's poor population.The World Bank said further poverty reduction would increasingly depend on creating more productive employment opportunities in these regions, particularly through better-quality non-farm jobs.More jobs, but wages remain stagnantIndia added around 134 million employed people between 2017 and 2023, nearly twice the increase in its working-age population. A significant share of this growth came from rural women entering paid employment, increasing the number of earning members in households.However, the rise in employment has not translated into comparable wage growth. The report noted that real earnings remained broadly unchanged, with much of the employment expansion concentrated in relatively low-productivity activities.It also flagged limitations in measuring inequality, noting that improvements in recent household surveys may account for part of the reported welfare gains, while wealthier households may not be fully represented, potentially leading to an underestimation of inequality.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: A North Dakota pipeline route drew objections from landowners and two counties over safety and local rules. A judge has now backed local setback powers and ordered more scrutiny, but the state permit remains in place
articles.summary: A North Dakota court has directed state regulators to take a closer look at the proposed Summit Carbon Solutions pipeline, raising fresh questions about
articles.body: A North Dakota court has directed state regulators to take a closer look at the proposed Summit Carbon Solutions pipeline, raising fresh questions about how safety concerns, local zoning rules and alternative routes should be assessed before major infrastructure projects are approved. The October 9 ruling by South Central District Court Judge Jackson Lofgren found that state pipeline-siting authority does not automatically override county zoning ordinances, according to North Dakota Monitor, with additional reporting from Montana Newsroom and Pipeline Fighters Hub. However, the decision did not cancel the route permit issued to Summit Carbon Solutions in November 2024. Instead, it requires the North Dakota Public Service Commission (PSC) to revisit several aspects of its approval process. The case was brought by landowners and Emmons and Burleigh counties, who challenged the commission’s handling of the proposed carbon dioxide pipeline. The ruling could also have implications for other infrastructure projects in the state, where the boundaries between state regulatory powers and local land-use authority have become a point of contention.Local zoning authority comes under scrutinyAt the centre of the dispute are setback requirements, which determine how far infrastructure must be located from homes and other buildings. Emmons and Burleigh counties have sought to enforce local rules governing pipeline placement, while the state’s permitting framework gives the PSC authority over pipeline routes.The court has instructed the commission to determine whether the counties’ setback requirements are unreasonable. If the restrictions are found to be unreasonable, state rules would apply. The question extends beyond Summit’s carbon pipeline. North Dakota lawmakers expanded similar statutory language in 2025 to give the PSC authority over power lines, bringing the relationship between state permitting and local zoning into focus for other infrastructure proposals.Safety and alternative routes require further reviewThe judge also found that regulators had not adequately explained why the proposed pipeline route would avoid impairing public welfare. The issue is particularly significant because the project would transport carbon dioxide under high pressure.During earlier proceedings, a PSC attorney argued that pipeline safety standards were enforced by a federal agency. The latest ruling, however, requires the commission to provide a clearer explanation of its assessment of public welfare, including the concerns raised in the case.Regulators must also revisit their analysis of an alternative route through southern Burleigh County. The court found the commission’s explanation of why that route had been sufficiently evaluated inadequate. Another issue concerns a model developed by Summit to estimate how carbon dioxide could spread if the pipeline ruptured. The PSC had agreed with the company that the model should remain confidential.The judge directed the commission to release a redacted version or provide a stronger justification for withholding it, particularly given evidence that some members of the public had been allowed to access the information. These issues will require further regulatory scrutiny, although the ruling does not itself establish that the proposed route is unsafe or that the alternative route must be selected.Summit project faces wider permitting hurdlesThe court ruling comes as Summit’s broader carbon capture and storage plans undergo significant changes. The company originally proposed collecting carbon dioxide emissions from ethanol plants across five Midwestern states and transporting them through a pipeline network for underground storage in North Dakota.However, the project has encountered repeated regulatory and legal obstacles. South Dakota regulators rejected Summit’s pipeline route application in April 2025, while separate North Dakota court rulings challenged the legal basis for its proposed underground storage sites.In May 2026, Summit announced plans to redirect its proposed pipeline towards an underground storage site in Wyoming, leaving the future of its North Dakota plans uncertain. The latest ruling adds another layer of regulatory review to the North Dakota project. The PSC must now address the court’s findings, including the treatment of county zoning restrictions, public welfare concerns and the disclosure of technical safety information. For now, the existing route permit remains valid. The next steps will depend on how the commission responds to the court’s directions and how Summit proceeds with its revised plans.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.
